classification: Candidate engineering interfaces and synthetic commissioning assumptions. No field device assigned.
robotFrame: mm; +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Carriage-local u starts at the translating receiver datum.

conventions.poseArray: carriage height above floor, outward slide extension
conventions.wheelbase: six-wheel differential, 580 mm track, nominal 152 mm wheels
conventions.grips: LeftGrip/RightGrip contact surfaces both move toward +X on release. Facing motor shaft signs are assigned by individual calibration.
conventions.detection: Seat and Entry are bottom-up occupancy signals through shelf optical ports; both can be true at the nominal seated center u=80 mm.
conventions.travel: Positive lift increases height; positive slide extends forward.

controlParameters.origin: Test hypotheses. Do not transfer values directly to hardware.

channels.interface: paired side motor/encoder requests and observations
channels.units: mm/s and mm of signed ground travel
channels.boundary: drive-owned; receiver supplies permit only. Drive must also enforce its own limits.
passive unpowered holding and limit switch elevations open

channels.interface: position goal and signed slide velocity, encoder, retracted/extended switches
channels.boundary: electrical zero, positive limit alignment and external stops open

channels.interface: velocity demand to opposed belt contacts
channels.boundary: paired gearing, electrical inversions, belt preload and roller encoder selection open
threshold, debounce, tube finish, full footprint and failure diagnostic open
earlier u=-60 mm fails geometric footprint; threshold and selectivity open

channels.interface: independent finite-pipe/shelf crossing bound for this acquisition
channels.units: active-attempt piece key, calibrated finite shelf gap >=1 mm, earliest/latest crossing timestamps in controller ms
channels.boundary: Shelf-only observation stops outward feed and holds the deployed slide.

channels.interface: drive/localization target clearance, dock and measured stop
channels.units: validity, oldest timestamp, and signed registered target sector in mm
channels.boundary: drive subsystem owns dock, obstacle/target occupancy, freshness and stop; incoming pose quality needs calibration

channels.interface: hardware diagnostics or operator-latched jam observation
channels.boundary: current sensor, thresholds, motion window, fault code and timeout calibration open

channels.interface: simulation-only independent front-plane measurement for the complete pose manifest
channels.units: assembly and study SHA-256, robot front frame, synchronized controller clock, piece, sector mm, exposure phase and capture ms, conservative gap mm
channels.boundary: Independent observed track identity and time origin survive acquisition. Match the archived image against the 361-body registered route and deadline before emitting slide velocity. The public command holds. Physical calibration, source of stable identity and bounded actuation lag remain open.
